name: player6_robust
description: Three-stage robustness tuning for Player6 over randomly generated markets. Stage 1 compares the four honesty settings, stage 2 replays every honesty x one-at-a-time parameter variant on the same markets, stage 3 re-checks the winners on fresh markets.
objective: Positive-happiness rate first (handout's primary goal), mean happiness as tie-break.
notes: A market fixes N, t, d, m, P, B, the list limit, the roster and the engine seed. Every variant replays the same market, so differences are paired.

bonus_ratio is B divided by the expected cost of a uniformly random marriage under that market's P (own decrement + half the partner's). 1.0 means a random marriage breaks even; B itself then spans a wide absolute range because d and P vary.
rounds is log-uniform; people is a uniform even number; m is uniform on 0..d.

Distribution kinds: preset = uniform/normal/mixed; groups = each dimension a submitted group row (or uniform/normal); random = each dimension a random shape (Dirichlet, off-centre normal, skewed, bimodal); hybrid = each dimension drawn from any of those.
Arena kinds: solo = every seat Player6; duel = Player6 vs one opponent code; field = Player6 vs a random subset of the other codes.
